shortDescription: Get available Cloud App Control rule actions by rule type

options.name: action_prefixes
options.description: Optional list of action prefixes to filter results. Valid values include C(ALLOW), C(DENY), C(BLOCK), C(CAUTION), C(ISOLATE), C(ESC). An underscore is automatically appended if not present. Only actions starting with these prefixes are included in C(filtered_actions).

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: cloud_apps
options.description: List of cloud application names to retrieve available actions for.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: query
options.description: An optional JMESPath expression applied locally to the flat list of action strings returned by the API. Use this for advanced client-side filtering/projection when C(action_prefixes) is not enough. The expression operates on a list of strings, so reference the current element with C(@) (e.g. C([?starts_with(@, 'ALLOW')])). Applied before the derived action lists are computed. See U(https://jmespath.org/) for the syntax.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: type
options.description: The rule type for the Cloud App Control policy (e.g., C(web), C(WEBMAIL), C(STREAMING_MEDIA)).

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.
